_about: Cyclohexane (1) + Tetrahydrofuran (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclohexane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of cyclohexane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Zhang, Z.[Zhigang], Jiang, P.[Peng], Huang, D.[Donghao], Lv, M.[Ming], Du, Y.[Yan], Li, W.[Wenxiu], Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Ternary and Binary Mixtures of Tetrahydrofuran, Cyclohexane, and 1,2-Propanediol at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 3054-3060
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10, 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0059. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.17 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
